turns.prose: The hearth crackles in the center of Hearth, casting a warm glow on the wooden benches. Ash and Wren sit across from each other, the scent of roasting meat lingering in the air. Ash leans forward, their voice low as they speak of the market news, while Wren's eyes reflect a growing concern. Wren's voice is steady but urgent as they discuss the dangers of the roads, their gaze fixed on Ash. "The roads are getting dangerous. Will you join me as my companion and fight at my side?" they ask, their hand resting on their longsword. Ash nods, their expression resolute. "Yes, I will come. The roads are indeed treacherous, and I believe we can watch each other's backs," they reply, their hand tightening around their own weapon.
